records.title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Performance and Marking
records.scope: Specifies minimum performance, construction, inspection, and marking requirements for industrial safety helmets intended to protect workers from falling objects and incidental impact in routine industrial and construction environments.
records.applicability: Applies to industrial safety helmets supplied for general workplace use; excludes helmets specifically designed for high-voltage electrical insulation, firefighting, sports, and motorcycling.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the referenced product control order is in force; otherwise this standard may be used for voluntary product conformity claims.
key_requirements: Shell material shall maintain structural integrity after impact testing.
Helmet suspension shall retain the shell and maintain clearance from the headform.
Chin-strap attachment, where provided, shall meet the specified retention performance.
Manufacturer shall control dimensions, materials, and production consistency.
testing_requirements: Impact attenuation test using specified impact energies and headform configuration.
Penetration resistance test using a controlled striker.
Retention-system performance test where a retention system is supplied.
Environmental conditioning before selected performance tests.
lab_evidence: Product test report identifying sample configuration and conditioning.
Test observations and measured impact/penetration results.
Laboratory statement linking sample identification to the tested production model.
documentation_required: Bill of materials or material declaration.

amendment.previous_requirement: Required the manufacturer identification and product model marking on the shell or label.
amendment.revised_requirement: Adds a batch or lot traceability mark and allows the mark to be placed on the shell or durable internal label.
amendment.reason_for_change: Improves traceability for production batches and field investigations without changing the core safety performance criteria.

records.title: Flexible Polymer Food Packs - Food Contact and Performance Requirements
records.scope: Covers flexible polymer films, pouches, and laminated packs intended for direct contact with dry, aqueous, or fatty foods under defined time and temperature conditions.
records.applicability: Applies to packaging materials used in food storage and distribution when the material is intended to contact food directly; does not cover reusable rigid containers or pharmaceutical packaging.
records.certification_applicability: Certification not automatically required by this standard alone; applicability depends on the product, applicable regulatory order, and conformity route selected by the organization.
key_requirements: Materials shall meet specified composition and migration criteria for the intended food-contact condition.
Pack seams and closures shall maintain integrity during the declared service conditions.
Odour and appearance shall remain within defined acceptance criteria after conditioning.
Packaging construction shall be traceable to a defined material and supplier specification.
testing_requirements: Overall migration test using the specified food simulant and exposure condition.
Seal strength test for applicable pouch and bag constructions.
Odour and sensory screening after conditioning.
lab_evidence: Migration test report with simulant, time, and temperature stated.
Seal strength measurements for representative production lots.
Material specification or certificate of composition from the supplier.
marking_requirements: Statement of intended food-contact use where required by the applicable conformity route.

records.title: Domestic Induction Cooking Appliances - Safety and Performance
records.scope: Specifies safety, electrical, thermal, and functional performance requirements for freestanding and countertop domestic induction cooking appliances supplied for household use.
records.applicability: Applies to induction hobs and portable induction cookers designed for household cooking; excludes commercial catering equipment and laboratory heating equipment.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a product-specific control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity assessment may be voluntary.
key_requirements: Electrical insulation and protective measures shall meet the specified safety criteria.
Accessible surfaces shall remain within defined temperature limits during declared use.
The appliance shall safely detect or respond to abnormal operating conditions.
Controls and indicators shall remain legible and function correctly.
testing_requirements: Temperature rise testing under representative load.
Abnormal operation and protective-device response testing.
lab_evidence: Temperature rise data for defined cooking-load conditions.
Abnormal operation test record with protective responses.
marking_requirements: Rated voltage, frequency, and power information.

records.title: Cementitious Repair Mortars - Industrial and Building Concrete Repair
records.scope: Specifies composition, fresh-state properties, hardened performance, and application-related requirements for pre-bagged cementitious repair mortars used for patching and restoration of concrete substrates.
records.applicability: Applies to non-structural and defined repair applications where the repair material is mixed and placed according to the manufacturer instructions; excludes resin-based repair systems.
records.certification_applicability: Certification generally voluntary unless a project specification, procurement condition, or applicable order requires conformity to this standard.
key_requirements: Specified compressive strength shall be achieved at the declared test age.
Fresh mortar shall meet workable consistency and water-demand limits.
Bond performance to the defined concrete substrate shall meet the acceptance threshold.
Packaging shall identify mixing instructions and declared batch information.
testing_requirements: Compressive strength test on prepared mortar specimens.
Bond strength or pull-off test on the defined substrate configuration.
lab_evidence: Strength test results by specimen and batch.
Bond test report identifying substrate and surface preparation.
marking_requirements: Batch number and date of manufacture.

records.title: LED Road Luminaires - Photometric, Electrical and Environmental Performance
records.scope: Specifies photometric, electrical, thermal, ingress-related, and marking requirements for LED road luminaires used on public and private roads, access ways, and comparable outdoor lighting installations.
records.applicability: Applies to LED luminaires with integral drivers intended for fixed outdoor installation; excludes decorative luminaires and portable work lights.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the relevant product control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity may be demonstrated through supplier declaration and test evidence.
key_requirements: Declared luminous performance shall be supported by photometric measurements.
Electrical input and protective measures shall meet the specified limits.
Thermal design shall maintain component temperatures within declared limits.
Enclosure and environmental protection shall match the declared installation condition.
testing_requirements: Photometric test and luminous flux verification.
Electrical safety and power-factor related checks where specified.
Environmental enclosure verification for the declared protection level.
lab_evidence: Photometric test report with mounting and operating conditions.
Thermal test data and enclosure verification record.
marking_requirements: Declared outdoor/environmental protection information and batch traceability.
documentation_required: Photometric file or equivalent laboratory output.

amendment.previous_requirement: Required declaration of rated input power and operating voltage.
amendment.revised_requirement: Adds maximum inrush current declaration for models using electronic drivers with active power management.
amendment.reason_for_change: Provides installers with additional information for circuit protection and commissioning calculations.

records.title: Stainless Steel Food-Contact Utensils - Hygiene and Material Requirements
records.scope: Specifies material, finish, corrosion resistance, cleanability, and marking requirements for stainless steel utensils and kitchenware intended for repeated food contact.
records.applicability: Applies to ladles, serving utensils, bowls, trays, and similar stainless steel kitchenware used in domestic or institutional food preparation and serving.
records.certification_applicability: Certification is not automatically required by the standard alone; it may become applicable through a product-specific order or contractual specification.
key_requirements: Food-contact surfaces shall use the declared stainless-steel grade or an approved equivalent within the demo specification.
Surfaces shall be reasonably smooth and cleanable for the intended use.
Joints and seams shall not create avoidable food-retention pockets in areas declared as food contact.
Products shall resist the defined corrosion screening exposure.
testing_requirements: Corrosion resistance screening under the defined exposure.
lab_evidence: Corrosion test observations and acceptance result.
Inspection record showing finish and workmanship.
marking_requirements: Batch or lot mark where traceability is claimed.
Material grade designation where required by the product specification.
documentation_required: Material grade certificate or supplier declaration.
Laboratory corrosion test report where applicable.

records.title: LPG Cabinet Heaters for Indoor Domestic Use - Safety Requirements
records.scope: Specifies safety, combustion, gas-tightness, burner, ignition, flame-failure, and marking requirements for cabinet-type LPG room heaters intended for indoor domestic use.
records.applicability: Applies to cabinet heaters using LPG supplied from portable cylinders under the defined appliance configuration; excludes industrial heaters and permanently installed central heating equipment.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a product-specific control order requires conformity to this standard; operation without the applicable conformity route is outside this demo dataset assumptions.
key_requirements: Gas-carrying components shall maintain gas-tightness over the declared operating range.
Burner combustion shall remain within the defined safety limits.
Flame-failure protection shall safely interrupt gas flow under the specified failure condition.
Hot-surface and ventilation warnings shall be provided as required.
lab_evidence: Abnormal-condition test evidence with appliance configuration.
marking_requirements: Gas type and rated heat input.

records.title: Modular Office Chairs - Structural Safety and Durability
records.scope: Specifies dimensional, structural, stability, adjustment, durability, and marking requirements for modular office chairs intended for seated work in offices and similar indoor environments.
records.applicability: Applies to adjustable and fixed office chairs assembled from modular components; excludes specialist medical seating and auditorium fixed seating.
records.certification_applicability: Certification generally voluntary unless required by procurement specifications or another applicable conformity instrument.
key_requirements: Chair structure shall withstand the specified static loading sequences.
Base and caster assembly shall maintain stability during prescribed movement conditions.
Adjustment mechanisms shall operate without unsafe release or unintended movement.
Repeated-use durability shall meet the defined cycle requirement.
testing_requirements: Seat, backrest, and armrest durability cycling where applicable.
lab_evidence: Structural test report with load sequence.
Stability and adjustment mechanism test record.
marking_requirements: Basic assembly and maximum-use information where relevant.

records.title: Rooftop Solar PV Mounting Systems - Mechanical and Installation Requirements
records.scope: Defines mechanical strength, corrosion protection, attachment, load-path, and installation documentation requirements for rooftop mounting systems supporting solar photovoltaic modules.
records.applicability: Applies to fixed rooftop mounting systems for small and medium distributed solar PV installations; excludes ground-mounted utility-scale systems and tracking structures.
records.certification_applicability: Certification may be required when the mounting product is covered by a procurement or project conformity specification; this standard alone does not universally mandate certification.
key_requirements: Mounting members shall withstand declared design loads for the installation zone.
Fasteners and attachment details shall maintain the specified load path.
Corrosion protection shall match the declared environmental exposure.
Installation documents shall identify permitted roof interfaces and tightening requirements.
testing_requirements: Mechanical load verification for representative assemblies.
Corrosion-protection verification by documented coating or material evidence.
lab_evidence: Mechanical load test report for the representative assembly.
marking_requirements: Material or coating identification where relevant.
Batch or component identification for traceable parts.
documentation_required: Declared load capacities and design assumptions.

records.title: uPVC Drainage Pipes - Gravity Drainage Service
records.scope: Specified dimensional, material, jointing, pressure-related, and workmanship requirements for unplasticized PVC drainage pipes used in gravity drainage applications.
records.applicability: Applied to uPVC gravity drainage pipes produced under the earlier demo specification; this record is retained for historical lookup and replacement tracing.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicability followed the conformity route attached to the earlier edition; it is not the current basis for new conformity claims in this demo dataset.
key_requirements: Pipe dimensions and wall thickness shall match the declared size series.
Material shall meet the earlier demo formulation limits.
Jointing surfaces shall remain compatible with the specified connection method.
Pipes shall meet the earlier stiffness and workmanship checks.
testing_requirements: Joint-leakage or watertightness check where applicable.
marking_requirements: Earlier standard number marking where historically applied.
documentation_required: Replacement mapping to the current demo standard.

records.title: uPVC Drainage Pipes - Gravity Drainage Service, Revised Requirements
records.scope: Specifies current dimensional, material, jointing, stiffness, and identification requirements for unplasticized PVC drainage pipes intended for gravity drainage service in buildings and site drainage systems.
records.applicability: Applies to new production and current conformity assessment for the defined uPVC drainage pipe range; the earlier 2023 demo edition is retained only as a superseded historical record.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where the current product control route adopts this standard; otherwise the standard may support voluntary or contractually required conformity.
key_requirements: Pipe dimensions and wall thickness shall meet the revised size-series tolerances.
Ring stiffness classification shall be declared and supported by test evidence.
Joint compatibility shall be demonstrated for the specified socket and seal configuration.
Permanent identification shall include current standard reference and traceability information.
testing_requirements: Ring stiffness or flattening-related performance test.
Impact/workmanship inspection where the declared application requires it.
lab_evidence: Stiffness results by representative pipe size.
Joint performance report using the declared seal/joint system.

records.title: Solar Water Heating Collectors - Domestic Thermal Systems
records.scope: Specified thermal efficiency, durability, connection, and basic safety requirements for domestic solar water-heating collectors used in small building-scale systems.
records.applicability: Applied to the earlier collector design classes covered by the demo catalogue; retained for historical searches and replacement tracing.
records.certification_applicability: Certification was applicable under the earlier demo conformity route when invoked by procurement or product-control conditions; current conformity should use the replacement record.
key_requirements: Collector shall achieve the declared thermal output under the defined test condition.
Hydraulic connections shall remain leak-tight under the specified pressure.
Thermal cycling shall not cause unacceptable functional damage.
Collector casing and support points shall remain secure.
testing_requirements: Thermal efficiency test under defined irradiance and inlet conditions.
documentation_required: Replacement mapping to the current standard.

records.title: Solar Water Heating Collectors - Domestic Thermal Systems, Current Requirements
records.scope: Specifies current thermal performance, pressure integrity, durability, materials, insulation, and marking requirements for domestic solar water-heating collectors used in building-scale hot-water systems.
records.applicability: Applies to current collector models intended for domestic or small institutional hot-water systems; the 2023 demo edition is superseded and retained only for historical traceability.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable when a product-control or procurement route explicitly requires this current edition; otherwise test evidence may support voluntary conformity.
key_requirements: Declared thermal performance shall be supported by the current test method and reporting format.
Collector circuit shall withstand the specified pressure and leakage checks.
Insulation and absorber construction shall maintain performance after durability conditioning.
Materials and coatings shall be suitable for the declared operating temperature and environment.
testing_requirements: Thermal performance test using the current conditioning and reporting method.
Thermal cycling and stagnation-related durability checks where applicable.
lab_evidence: Pressure integrity report for the representative collector.
marking_requirements: Current standard number and traceability mark.

records.title: Electric Storage Water Heaters - Domestic Safety and Energy Performance
records.scope: Specifies electrical safety, thermal performance, pressure containment, controls, energy-performance declaration, and marking requirements for domestic electric storage water heaters.
records.applicability: Applies to fixed electric storage water heaters for domestic hot-water service within the declared capacity range; excludes instantaneous heaters and industrial hot-water vessels.
records.certification_applicability: Certification applicable where a relevant product control order adopts this standard; otherwise conformity assessment may be voluntary or procurement-driven.
key_requirements: Tank and pressure-containing parts shall withstand the specified pressure condition.
Electrical protection shall address insulation, leakage, and protective-device operation.
Thermostatic controls shall maintain the declared water-temperature range.
Energy-performance information shall be supported by the stated test method.
testing_requirements: Thermostat and safety cut-out function test.
